name: referral-strategy + networking-message-writer chain
description: Tests that referral-strategy identifies the optimal referral path and contact approach, and networking-message-writer produces a personalized, non-generic cold outreach message.

input.user_message: 我想内推进字节跳动数据平台部门的数据工程师岗位。我在领英上找到了两个人：一个是字节的数据工程师（和我同校，但不认识），一个是数据平台部门的组长（我们有共同前同事）。帮我制定策略并写消息。

candidate_profile.background: 3年数据工程经验，Spark/Flink方向，现在一家B2B SaaS公司

mutual_connections.contact_b: 前同事王某在该组长团队工作过

assertions: referral-strategy recommends contact_b (team lead with mutual connection) as the higher-priority target
strategy includes the tactic of mentioning the mutual former colleague Wang in the message to contact_b
networking-message-writer produces two distinct messages tailored to each contact's relationship type
message to contact_a leverages the alumni connection without being presumptuous
message to contact_b references the mutual connection by name as the opening hook
both messages are under 200 characters for the opening line (WeChat/LinkedIn norm)
messages do not make demands — they ask for a brief conversation or referral consideration
must_not_contain: a single generic message sent to both contacts
messages that immediately ask for a referral in the first sentence without context
invented details about the candidate's relationship with the contacts
messages longer than what is appropriate for a cold LinkedIn/WeChat reach-out
